assumptions: The red block is placed at (0,0,0) within the upper-left grid cell.
"lengthwise" for the green block implies its longer dimension (z-axis) is aligned with the z-axis of the grid, making its dimensions (2,1,4).

"rotated so that it's oriented this way" for the blue block implies its longer dimension (x-axis) is aligned with the x-axis of the grid, making its dimensions (4,1,2), and it is rotated 90 degrees relative to the green block.
"two little pips poking out on each side" and "two pips hanging off of each side" means an overhang of 1 unit on each side of the supporting block's footprint in the relevant dimension.
